title: With Make new Chromium tab pages ahead on, a new Chromium tab the person opens takes the page made ahead: one Back entry, the page sized to its pane, DevTools attaches
why: HOT PATH AUDIT browser (#34252): with the Debug Setting browserPage.sparePage on (off by default), a new Chromium tab's browser is a spare page made at an idle moment in the hidden spare window, frozen while it waits, and thawed by the tab that takes it. Only a tab the person opens takes it: a socket action.run opens an agent's tab (origin cli, agent-driven, unselected), which keeps tab_add. So both tabs here open as the person's: the first with Cmd-Shift-L and a typed address, the second with debug.new_tab's run (the action with origin user, a link opened in a new tab). Each Chromium tab has a Chromium window of its own, so the second tab's window is the spare window it takes, with the page already in it. The journey waits until debug.cef reports a page waiting, proves the second tab took it (spare_pages_taken rises), then checks on the real fork what the stand-in shim tests cannot: one history entry (the page was made with an empty URL, so no blank entry before the tab's first navigation), a viewport equal to its pane's page area, and DevTools attaching to it. The setting is reset at the end.
source: coordinator review of #34252 (hpa-browser), item 4; re-review at 82b52979, item 2; third review at 104e8cca

steps.title: turn on Debug Settings > Browser Page Loading > Make new Chromium tab pages ahead
the person's first Chromium tab (Cmd-Shift-L): Chromium starts
its address bar takes the keys
the first tab shows example.com, and the spare window came up after its window
no input: the next idle moments (0.75 s each) make the spare page in the spare window
a spare page waits; the takes so far are kept
the person's second Chromium tab (a link opened in a new tab, origin user): its window is the spare window, and it takes the page in it
the second tab took the spare page, shows its page, and its page area is laid out
one history entry (no blank entry before the first navigation); the page's viewport is its pane's page area (points, rounded)

params.expression: 'hist=' + history.length + ' ' + (innerWidth === Math.round(Number('${page_w}')) && innerHeight === Math.round(Number('${page_h}')) ? 'sized' : 'unsized ' + innerWidth + 'x' + innerHeight + ' pane ${page_w}x${page_h}')

steps.title: Developer Tools: Open Docked on the taken page
DevTools attached to the taken page, docked beside it

finally.title: put Make new Chromium tab pages ahead back to its default (off)
